title: My Name Is Not Refugee ⛵️🚚 |   Refugee Week  | Kids Story Read Aloud  | Comprehension Qs
fulltitle: My Name Is Not Refugee ⛵️🚚 |   Refugee Week  | Kids Story Read Aloud  | Comprehension Qs
description:
Hi teachers, parents and children. 

This is a story about the changes and the journey a young child will have to go through to be safe. Many young people all over the world right now do not have a safe place to sleep or even food/water to drink. 

Refugee week this year is from the 20th - 26th June. It is an opportunity to raise awareness, build empathy and a chance to give those that have been through this an opportunity to heal. 

There are points in this text that teachers/parents can stop at as questions have been included by the author. I have also added my own follow on questions that children can put their answers down for. 

1. What would you take? 
This begs the questions - how many of your precious items would/could you fit into  a backpack? All your toys? or would it be just necessities? 

2. Do you always hold onto an adults hand when you should? 
This could probe the question what would happen to the child if they let go of their parents hand whilst travelling? 

3. Do you like cars and lorries? 
How do you think it feels to be walking near cars/lorries? Would it be a safe situation? 

4. Where would you brush your teeth or change your pants?
Why is there no privacy? How would that make you feel? 

5. What games can you think of? Can you plug in your tablet anywhere (no)? How would you spend your time? 

Disclaimer

Published by The Bucket List (2017)
